headline: Argentina Central Bank Outlines Swap Strategy with China and US
summary: BCRA President Santiago Bausili outlined plans to utilize currency swaps with China and the United States to manage foreign exchange volatility ahead of 2027, and confirmed Argentine gold reserves are hedged through Deutsche Bank.
why: Argentina's central bank operates with scarce net international reserves, making bilateral currency swaps and gold management critical for peso stabilization.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Deploying bilateral swaps provides emergency FX liquidity but increases bilateral sovereign obligations.
